findings.description: plans/crews-integration.md still cites the legacy `b-inflight` badge model when describing how the codexu lead skill discovers in-flight tasks. Two passages reference it: (a) line 132 quotes `.agents/skills/roadmap-and-overview/SKILL.md`'s old wording "Scan plans/overview.html for tasks with `b-inflight` badges" as if that wording were current; (b) line 139 prescribes a future migration step that says replace "scan plans/overview.html for tasks with `b-inflight` badges + `cmd-warn blocked` banners" with `/list-members --crew codexu`. After this diff lands, SKILL.md no longer mentions `b-inflight` — step 3 of "First five things to do" now reads tasks whose `data-task-phase` ends in `-in-progress` (plus `cmd-warn blocked` banners). So the quoted source string in crews-integration.md no longer exists in the file it points to, making the planned crews-side replacement instruction misaligned with reality.
findings.resolution: Updated both stale b-inflight references in crews-integration.md to data-task-phase ending in -in-progress
findings.suggestedFix: Update both passages in plans/crews-integration.md to track the new phase model. For line 132 (bullet under "Fresh-agent orientation"): change "tasks with `b-inflight` badges" to "tasks whose `data-task-phase` ends in `-in-progress`". For line 139 (action item under the migration list): change the quoted source string from "scan plans/overview.html for tasks with `b-inflight` badges + `cmd-warn blocked` banners" to "scan plans/overview.html for tasks whose `data-task-phase` ends in `-in-progress` or that have `cmd-warn blocked` banners" so the before/after replacement still matches the actual SKILL.md text the crews migration would supersede.
